message:
Running command: set -e
echo "OS info (for scheduling context):"
(cat /etc/os-release || true) | sed -n '1,8p'
echo "User ID: $(id -u)"

# 1) Create cleanup script
sudo_cmd=''
if [ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ]; then
  if command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo_cmd='sudo'; fi
fi

$sudo_cmd mkdir -p /usr/local/bin
$sudo_cmd tee /usr/local/bin/cleanup_tmp.sh >/dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin

ts() { date -Is 2>/dev/null || date; }

LOCKDIR="/tmp/.cleanup_tmp.lock.d"
if mkdir "$LOCKDIR" 2>/dev/null; then
  trap 'rmdir "$LOCKDIR"' EXIT INT TERM
else
  exit 0
fi

echo "[$(ts)] cleanup_tmp: start"

# Prune certain system-managed areas that shouldn't be touched
PRUNE_EXPR="( -path /tmp/systemd-private-* -o -path /tmp/snap.* ) -prune -o"

# Remove regular files not accessed or modified in the last 1 day
find /tmp -xdev -mindepth 1 \
  \( -path /tmp/systemd-private-* -o -path /tmp/snap.* \) -prune -o \
  \( -type f \( -atime +1 -o -mtime +1 \) -print -delete \)

# Remove symlinks older than 1 day
find /tmp -xdev -mindepth 1 \
  \( -path /tmp/systemd-private-* -o -path /tmp/snap.* \) -prune -o \
  \( -type l \( -atime +1 -o -mtime +1 \) -print -delete \)

# Remove empty directories older than 2 days
find /tmp -xdev -mindepth 1 \
  \( -path /tmp/systemd-private-* -o -path /tmp/snap.* \) -prune -o \
  \( -type d -empty -mtime +2 -print -delete \)

# Extra cleanup for common tmp patterns older than 7 days
find /tmp -xdev -mindepth 1 \
  \( -path /tmp/systemd-private-* -o -path /tmp/snap.* \) -prune -o \
  \( -type f \( -name 'tmp-*' -o -name 'sess_*' -o -name '*.tmp' \) -mtime +7 -print -delete \)

echo "[$(ts)] cleanup_tmp: done"
EOF
$sudo_cmd chmod +x /usr/local/bin/cleanup_tmp.sh

# 2) Schedule hourly via cron.hourly if available
if [ -d /etc/cron.hourly ]; then
  echo "Setting up /etc/cron.hourly/cleanup-tmp"
  $sudo_cmd tee /etc/cron.hourly/cleanup-tmp >/dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
/usr/local/bin/cleanup_tmp.sh >>/var/log/cleanup_tmp.log 2>&1
EOF
  $sudo_cmd chmod +x /etc/cron.hourly/cleanup-tmp
fi

# 3) Also add a crontab entry as a fallback (runs at minute 0 every hour)
if command -v crontab >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Installing crontab entry to run hourly"
  ( crontab -l 2>/dev/null | sed '/\/usr\/local\/bin\/cleanup_tmp\.sh/d'; \
    echo '0 * * * * /usr/local/bin/cleanup_tmp.sh >>/var/log/cleanup_tmp.log 2>&1' ) | crontab -
else
  echo "crontab command not found; relying on /etc/cron.hourly if present."
fi

# 4) Run once now and show output
echo "Running initial cleanup..."
/usr/local/bin/cleanup_tmp.sh | $sudo_cmd tee -a /var/log/cleanup_tmp.log >/dev/null || true
echo "Last 50 lines of /var/log/cleanup_tmp.log (if exists):"
$sudo_cmd tail -n 50 /var/log/cleanup_tmp.log 2>/dev/null || echo "No log file yet."
